Terminal state precedes guarded payout; bounded native push, deferred credit, checks-effects-interactions withdrawal and forced surplus have fixed destinations. Canonical profile verifies no signatures on-chain and requires qualified plain exact-transfer tokens.
Reviewed all source: isolated escrows(bytes32) six-word ABI, registry chain/genesis/runtime identity, finalized-only anchors and repeated anchor checks; no latest fallback.

Exact expectation and receipt hash/from/to/input/value/nonce binding; receipt pending, failed, reorged and unknown remain distinct. Trusted preparation must bind expected calldata to the intended action.

Four physical jobs, bounded code/calldata/deadline and fixed errors; cancellation/disposal suppress late work while ignored-abort requests retain admission. RPC consistency is not independent chain verification.
Reviewed baseline facade and current additive boundary: diagnostic errors, registry, terms, privacy, journey and hints; no journal writes or provider/send capability exported.
Concurrent T80 adds two trade-draft export lines. Their boundary is recorded; trade-draft implementation is explicitly excluded and must be covered by T80 plus root consolidated validation.
Reviewed all source and authority tests: exact binding/generation/latest request and native-reader capability remain separate from untrusted observation/source labels.
Contradictory native state/height/hash/finality latches reorged until an agreeing observation; freshness, four physical slots, local fiat separation and disabled economic authority remain explicit.
Reviewed all source: fixed code/action/retry projections, descriptor-safe foreign error classification and no raw provider diagnostics.
A send-started failure always remains unknown; operation-ID fallback is bounded diagnostic correlation, never a transaction/security nonce.
Reviewed all source: captured vault session lease/epoch/revision, bounded strict scan, record-kind/schema/payload/ID uniqueness and CAS; random record IDs cannot overwrite another kind.

Trusted exact canonical validator has no permissive default. Prepared reserve and durable send marker precede any consumer send; hash is learned once, marker uncertainty is conservative, conflicting nonce/binding/account reservations block.

Native terminal authorization is ephemeral, exact-bound and reobserved after restore; explicit lifecycle transitions and same-nonce successors prevent hash rewriting/backwards state. No send surface, elapsed-time unlock or automatic resend; one physical job persists through cancellation.
Reviewed all source: diagnostic projection has no actions/economic preparation; chain health and unresolved intent veto historical terminal receipts and recovery keeps the original binding.

Optional trusted native G18 guidance must match funded binding/hash/finalized anchor; composition and scope are reread after await, then latest guidance/current checks precede output. Receipt projection does not establish actual delivery of a deferred payout.
Reviewed all source: constructor-issued publisher closures bind maker/order; relay/journal hints never become native or economic authority.
30-second TTL, one timer, at most 64 observers, bounded stable notification cohort and finite sequence; reentry, disconnect, disposal and clock invalidation retire owned outputs.
Reviewed all source: fixture-only evaluator checks exact terms/binding/units/anchors/finality, freshness and 900-second margin.
Imported fixture labels cannot establish native truth; output is explicitly fixture evidence with economic preparation false.
Reviewed all source: display-only observations keep route, vault, messaging, proof and configured endpoint disclosures independent; selected policy is not observed coverage.

Endpoint output contains normalized origins only, no credentials/path/query; bounded 32 rows/30-second lifetime, exact shapes, scope/generation/completion-clock checks, reversal latch, disposal and reentry prevent stale positive publication.
Strict policy blocks observed direct paths without granting spend or routing authority; transport implementations are owned by the separate reviewer.
Reviewed all source: authorized idempotent reads only; at most 3 attempts, 10-second attempt deadline, 35-second total budget and fixed full-jitter ceilings.

No next attempt until prior physical work settles; fixed descriptor-safe errors and checks after runtime callbacks suppress stale/aborted/reentrant output; timers/listeners clean up. This wrapper is never used for sending.
Reviewed all source: intrinsic byte-view length cap precedes owned native copy; exact expected manifest digest precedes strict parsing.

Frozen registry, pinned successful digest and concurrent-load conflict forbid silent trust-root replacement; caller supplies the authorized digest, no default production network/deployment is invented.

Reviewed all baseline and T88 repaired source: strict 64 KiB UTF8/JSON container, canonical public units/IDs/times, exact private/capability encodings and hashes, order/revision and loaded registry asset/deployment checks.

Snapshot-once fields, deep-frozen exact display and explicit unsupported capabilities provide review, never signatures, acceptance or native approval. Registry/hash capabilities are trusted composition inputs.

T88 now checks native view byte length before allocation and copies only the bounded intrinsic offset/range. Existing fixed rejection codes, detached-view behavior,65536/65537 boundaries and untouched caller bytes are retained.
Reviewed all source: read-only authority/journal join uses exact binding/account/generation and rechecks wallet/current after awaited reads.
Owned supersession/cancellation handles reentry; immutable diagnostic output remains false economic preparation and exposes no writes/sends.

Reviewed all source: exact records/dense arrays, intrinsic string bounds before UTF8 allocation, lone-surrogate refusal, sorted unique bounded capabilities, salted/prefixed private encodings and canonical fiat/revision units.

Funding uses strict acceptance and inclusive 1800..604800-second duration; Solana byte encoding is a documented development convention, not a native program/SPL qualification. Pure hash/encoding utilities confer no signing or chain authority.

Reviewed all source: captured wallet function, explicit live prepared capability, exact context/generation, native nonce/state reads and trusted canonical journal validator; durable reserve/send marker precede one explicit send.

Cancellation after marker prevents invocation but preserves unknown recovery; hashes/receipts match native transaction input/value/nonce/from/to and anchors. Reorg revokes terminal authorization; restored labels require reobservation.

Recovery does not resend; replacement/drop requires explicit same-nonce successor.4001 is the existing EIP1193 known-rejection policy, not a guarantee for dishonest providers. Legacy per-instance queues/maps require caller admission and are outside default App activation.

Reviewed all source: separate isolated signature-checking profile pins network/deployment IDs and token runtime hashes, checks both EOA/EIP1271 acceptances and fixed core capabilities, enforces seller funding/release and bound seller refund.

One-use trade/nonce, positive units/revision, exact deadlines, exact seller debit/escrow receipt at funding and escrow debit/recipient receipt at payout; guarded liability updates roll back atomically on failure.

Failed payout reverts to funded rather than canonical deferred credit. Runtime hash cannot prove token honesty, proxy implementation or mutable signer policy. No admin/redirection/production authority.
Reviewed all source: explicit-call pinned solc 0.8.38 build, optimizer 200/viaIR/Shanghai and restricted OpenZeppelin imports; compile also includes declared unsafe test actors as fixtures.
Importing does not compile/deploy; source and ABI/bytecode artifacts are local templates, not evidence of deployed runtime identity.
Reviewed all source: explicit local-only compile/version evidence, bounded 5-second/4096-byte native version subprocess, exact lock/binary/template hashes and ReleaseEnabled=0.
No external endpoint, deployment or signing action; an evidence script is not qualification of third-party native/compiler binaries.
Reviewed all source: narrow read-only contract-acceptance observation/types/limits facade; no signing, funding or send exports.

Reviewed all source: explicit 3-second discovery with 64 announcement/16 provider bounds; descriptor-only unverified metadata/no icon loading, weak provider identities and exact-generation opaque handles.
Checks follow reflection/RNG callbacks; owned timers/listeners and disposal retire late announcements. Discovery invokes no automatic wallet method or spending capability.
Reviewed all source: explicit lifecycle-owned connect/session generation; frozen terms/registry/deployment/asset/role binding and native account/chain checks before typedData v4 prompt.

Final own-descriptor account snapshot and captured request precede final current guard; offline signature recovery and late suppression preserve exact role/account. No send capability; legacy chain-quantity ceiling can fail closed above 64 bits.
Reviewed all source: exact private/capability/order/revision/hash consistency and two distinct role/account-bound EOA acceptances with canonical EIP712 encoding.

Owned buffer wipe and checks across asynchronous digests suppress stale/cancelled results; native context/hash capabilities are trusted. Test-only output keeps economic preparation false; wiping is no physical erasure guarantee.
Reviewed all source: EIP1271 local read-only observation, native signal validation, jobs 2/signature 4096/code 24576/gas 100000/timeout <=30s and exact magic-word ABI checks.

Repeated chain/genesis/deployment/latest-anchor/wallet-code/registry checks, signature wipe and physical-drain admission; no EOA fallback, durable approval or authority over mutable contract-wallet/proxy policy.

Reviewed all source: canonical selectors/events/tuple offsets/implied constants and six-word getTrade layout; frozen domain/terms, canonical decimal uint bounds, exact principal allowance and zero-reset plan.

Strict ABI/log/revert words and absent all-zero slot; pending credits/withdraw use a fixed bound destination. Raw log folding is diagnostic rather than authenticated state; raw collection utilities rely on caller input admission.

Reviewed baseline and T88 repaired source: strict canonical prepared JSON plus exact account/chain/nonce/generation, trusted canonical validator, durable reserve/marker and one explicit invocation; errors after marker remain unknown and never resend.

T88 rejects account accessors without invocation, rechecks scope after final account reflection and captures request+receiver before final guard. Synthetic negative controls demonstrate the baseline invocation defect and repaired zero-call behavior.

Physical slot persists through ignored cancellation. Normal execution parses the bounded schema intent before its private request parser; the separately exported low-level helper is not a stand-alone arbitrary-size input boundary.

Repeated chain/genesis/anchor checks, 30-second monotonic freshness/900-second safety margin and one physical read through ignored-abort drain; fixed errors, bounded timeout, no retries/sends and false economic preparation.

Canonical action builders/prior states expose no signing or sends. Legacy raw data() validation/provider allocations lack a stand-alone byte cap; trusted transport/lifecycle owns admission. No claim that arbitrary provider objects are resource-safe.
Reviewed all source: exact own-data snapshots, canonical addresses/IDs/u64/u256 and fixed EIP712 domain/type/order; role selects the stored account.

Intrinsic65-byte signature copy,27/28 recovery ID, range/low-s and pinned Noble recovery with prehash false; no custom signing/provider/send implementation. Pin correspondence is not independent cryptographic proof.

findings.title: Final session guard precedes foreign reflection before send-capable invocation
findings.basis: Exact baseline source/caller review and three synthetic in-memory negative cases; no real wallet/provider or broadcast.
findings.impact: Synchronous final account/request reflection could retire a session immediately before invoking its send-capable port; the existing durable marker still prevents automatic replay.
findings.red: Exact final tests on baseline: 11 pass/3 fail, one synthetic invocation per negative case.
findings.green: 14/14; zero synthetic sends or account-accessor invocations in the negative cases; marker remains broadcast-unknown and explicit retry conflicts.

findings.title: Intrinsic terms-byte cap applied only after an oversized owned copy
findings.basis: Exact byte-copy source boundary and bounded 65537-byte max+1 negative case, plus valid offset-view and detached-view controls.
findings.impact: The previous shadowable length check could allocate an oversized caller view before eventual strict-parser refusal; poisoned accessors also rejected valid bounded offset views.
findings.red: 16 tests:14 pass/2 fail; max+1 incurred one owned allocation before refusal.
findings.green: 36/36 focused terms/registry/encoding checks; max+1 causes zero owned allocation/accessor/digest/registry work, valid intrinsic offset copy preserves caller bytes.

limits: Whole-source defensive review is not a professional security certification, formal proof, release qualification or proof of absence of defects. Production trading remains disabled.

Finality and native reads trust injected RPC/registry/composition capabilities; consistent dishonest RPC, mutable contract-wallet policies, proxy implementation changes, chain failure and token honesty remain external assumptions.
Canonical and isolated profiles are distinct; matching terms digests do not make their selectors/getters/signature/payout policies interchangeable.

No real funds, third-party target, exploit reproduction, external network operation, deployment, key use, signing or broadcast was performed. Test-only source inclusion in this audit does not activate it in the App.
Seller withholding after manual fiat payment and issuer freeze/censorship are accepted economic/liveness risks, not solved by native escrow authorization.

Legacy raw calldata/log helpers and private lifecycle admission rely partly on caller bounds. This review does not assert every arbitrary caller/provider object or upstream dependency is globally resource bounded.

T80 trade-draft implementation, transport/messaging, crypto/storage internals, all third-party code/native binaries and live deployments are outside this slice; dependency hashes are checkpoints rather than those separate reviews.
